title: sro-noise-floor: exact finite-size statistics for Warren-Cowley short-range-order parameters
description: Exact mean and covariance of Warren-Cowley short-range-order parameters for a random arrangement of atoms in a finite periodic supercell (any lattice, composition, cell size and coordination shells), an unbiased estimator, significance tests (single-parameter, global chi-squared, permutation), a POSCAR command-line tool, and scripts reproducing all figures.
